Tremors felt across multiple districts in Maharashtra's Nashik region

Mild tremors, with magnitudes up to 3.6, were recorded in Maharashtra's Nashik district and surrounding areas. The seismic activity was also noted in Palghar and Hingoli districts. The event signifies minor geological shifts in the region.
